ShareToken

Stores universe-aware ERC-1155 outcome shares and materializes a holder's persistent source entitlement in selected fork branches. ShareToken source contract

Read surface

Base and relationship getters are name, symbol, zoltar, canonicalPoolByUniverse, recoveredCompleteSetShares, _balances, _supplies, and _operatorApprovals. Standard ERC-1155 reads are supportsInterface, balanceOf, totalSupply, balanceOfBatch, and isApprovedForAll; protocol-specific reads are isAuthorized, totalSupplyForOutcome, maximumOutcomeSupply, balanceOfOutcome, balanceOfShares, getMigratedShareAmountAttoShares, getTokenId, getTokenIds, unpackTokenId, isPortfolioRecoveryEligible, and balanceOfPortfolioRecoveryRights. The eligibility getter applies the source recovery rules, preserving ordinary source-pool redemption for protected finalized questions. The balance getter returns unspent Invalid, Yes and No recovery rights, or all zeros when ineligible; the minimum bounds complete-set cash recovery. Received rights are included independently of the holder’s source-token balances.

State-changing interactions

Each call lists its parameter names in ABI order. The contract index defines the columns.

Transaction Caller Main prerequisites State or asset effect Primary signals
setApprovalForAll(operator, approved) Any token account setting its own operator approval The operator differs from the caller. Sets or clears the operator's authority over all of the caller's outcome-token balances. ApprovalForAll
safeTransferFrom(from, to, id, value) and safeTransferFrom(from, to, id, value, data) Share holder or approved ERC-1155 operator Caller holds the source balance or has operator approval; the source account has neither materialized that token into a child branch nor spent source-backed recovery rights by transferring or consuming them; destination is nonzero; the source balance is sufficient; under A22 asset-recipient compatibility, a contract recipient accepts the ERC-1155 callback. Transfers one outcome-token balance without changing supply. TransferSingle
safeBatchTransferFrom(from, to, ids, values) and safeBatchTransferFrom(from, to, ids, values, data) Source account or approved ERC-1155 operator ID and value array lengths match; caller is the source account or has operator approval; destination is nonzero; no listed source token is locked by child materialization or spending source-backed recovery rights; source balances are sufficient. Under A22 asset-recipient compatibility, a contract recipient must accept the ERC-1155 callback, including for an empty batch. Transfers each listed outcome-token balance without changing supply. Empty batches change no balances. TransferBatch, including empty batches
transferPortfolioRecoveryRights(sourceUniverse, recipient, amountsAttoShares) Recovery-right holder transferring only their own rights; ERC-1155 operator approval does not authorize this call Canonical source is a portfolio question in a forked universe with isPortfolioRecoveryEligible(sourceUniverse) == true (No live source recovery right); recipient is a different nonzero account; at least one amount is positive; every amount fits its corresponding unspent recovery-right balance. Transfers the specified Invalid, Yes and No recovery rights independently. Source and child token balances and every branch migration entitlement remain intact. Received credits are spent first; spending source-backed rights locks that source token against transfer. No token-receiver callback is invoked. PortfolioRecoveryRightsTransferred
consumePortfolioRecoveryCompleteSets(sourceUniverse, holder, amountAttoShares) The canonical source pool’s portfolio or its configured fork coordinator Canonical source is a portfolio question in a forked universe with isPortfolioRecoveryEligible(sourceUniverse) == true (No live source recovery right); positive amount no greater than any of the holder’s three unspent recovery-right balances. The coordinator authenticates the holder and calculates the corresponding cash payout. Consumes equal amounts of Invalid, Yes and No recovery rights, using independently received credits before source-backed rights. Spending a source-backed right locks that source token against transfer; spending received credits alone does not. Source balances and every branch’s migration rights remain intact. Returns cumulative consumed shares. PortfolioRecoveryRightsConsumed
migrate(fromId, targetOutcomeIndexes) Holder of the source token ID Source universe forked; canonical source pool is Operational or PoolForked, and an Operational source has no inherited fixed outcome because auto-fork activation rejects one; positive source balance; nonempty, strictly increasing, well-formed outcomes; every target in a multi-target call already has a canonical child pool; after the branch-creation window, a single target must also already exist; each target is an immediate native child, including when its bound question contract skips intermediate reporter ancestors; at least one selected child has an unmaterialized balance; under A22 asset-recipient compatibility, a contract holder accepts onERC1155Received for every target mint. If needed, first freezes the operational source pool and records its fork snapshot. A single-target call may lazily create that child while the branch-creation window is open. It keeps and locks the holder's source entitlement, then mints each selected child-universe token ID up to the current source balance. Later source additions materialize only the unminted delta. A contract holder receives the ERC-1155 single-receiver callback for each mint; rejection rolls back the mint and preceding fork or child setup. Canonical child preparation may emit SecurityPoolRegistered, DeploySecurityPool, and share-token AuthorizationUpdated. Successful materialization emits ERC-1155 TransferSingle and Migrate for each target.
authorize(securityPoolCandidate) Initially authorized SecurityPoolFactory for an origin pool; an authorized parent SecurityPool for a child pool Caller is already authorized; the candidate reports this exact share token; its universe has no different canonical pool. Establishes the candidate as canonicalPoolByUniverse for its universe and adds it to the set allowed to mint, burn, and authorize descendants. Reauthorizing the same candidate is a no-op. AuthorizationUpdated on first authorization; no event when the same candidate is already authorized
mintCompleteSets(universeId, account, amountAttoShares) An authorized SecurityPool Caller is authorized; account is nonzero; amountAttoShares is positive; under A22 asset-recipient compatibility, a contract account accepts onERC1155BatchReceived. Mints amountAttoShares each of Invalid, Yes, and No to account, then invokes its ERC-1155 batch-receiver callback when it is a contract. Rejection rolls back the mint and the authorized pool's surrounding transaction. TransferBatch on a successful callback
burnCompleteSets(universeId, owner, amountAttoShares) An authorized SecurityPool Caller is authorized; owner is nonzero and has at least amountAttoShares of every outcome. Each remaining source balance must still cover its already-separated recovery rights. Burns amountAttoShares each of Invalid, Yes, and No from owner; global outcome supplies may differ. TransferBatch
burnTokenIdAndGetRemainingSupply(tokenId, owner) An authorized SecurityPool owner is nonzero; caller is authorized; no source-backed recovery rights have already been separated for this token. Burns owner's full balance of tokenId and returns the burned amount and that token ID's remaining supply. TransferSingle, including when the burned balance is zero
